name: attic/activecells-sharp
description: ActiveCells# -- a C#-flavoured syntax over the ActiveCells model, from Alexey Gokhberg's parser.
residual: Not C# and not ours: the scanner has `cell`, `cellnet`, `port` and `select` beside `class` and `switch`, and FoxGlobal carries @lynx_* and lynx@send for it. Fox is a framework with pluggable front ends and somebody hung a second language on it.
Nothing in the tree names it. It reached the SDK until 2026-08-16 only because an import graph cannot tell a front end loaded by name from any other module loaded by name.
